review.independent_source_reading: On T8_page-4.png, the paragraph and item 8.8 present four distinct conditions N, R, G, B for the four categories a, b, c, d, supporting a bijective assignment. The chart has no legend-coded stack at a, while b, c, and d have stacks. Their blue-hatched H2 portions have the clear strict order b > c > d (approximately 28%, 8%, and 4%). For the named LEDs, the standard visible-color wavelength order and E = hc/λ give photon energies B > G > R. T8_page-3.png shows Gibbs state-level changes but no LED-indexed selectivity relation, activation barriers, or optical thresholds. Thus the pages alone do not complete the assignment; with the separately approved finite contest-model inputs M001 and M002, the unique classification is a=N, b=B, c=G, d=R.
nonblocking_notes: Approval is within the authorized contest-model proof scope. M001 and M002 remain non-empirical conditional model inputs, not conclusions established by the pages.
